_comment: App Runner INSTANCE role — the permissions the running backend container has.
Attach to role dreamforge-apprunner-instance, trusted by
Note what is absent and must stay absent: lambda:InvokeFunction. The backend
must have no path to the creative agent — the agent is started by its
schedule alone. Also absent: dynamodb:Scan (nothing needs a full table read)
and any access to the history table (that belongs to the agent).
